title: Stripe payments
summary: Registers a PaymentGateway into the kernel payment-method shell. Card, PayPal, Bancontact, Google Pay, Apple Pay.

blocks.title: Do not edit the payment-method shell
blocks.text: api.registerPaymentGateway. Checkout lists methods only while this plugin is on. Saved cards and webhooks live in this package.
Env secrets stay in this plugin's Stripe client. Kernel checkout never names Stripe in extraLines.
